crossRefs.note: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
the sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
(For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
“Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

translations.web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
translations.bsb: In your days, have you commanded the morning or assigned the dawn its place,
translations.kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
translations.asv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began, And caused the dayspring to know its place;
